name: Mac battery
author: ryan
description: Shows the MacBook battery in the Omarchy bar by reading omarchy-utm-battery.json from a UTM shared folder. While enabled, the widget re-reads that file every five seconds. It does not use the network.

barWidget.description: MacBook charge and charging state from a UTM shared folder.

schema.label: Status file
schema.description: Guest path of omarchy-utm-battery.json. Empty tries ~/Mac, ~/Shared, /mnt/utm, and /mnt/share.
